description: Source code for a Linux kernel driver handling memory-mapped register access for a B53 switch device.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_read8(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u8 * val)
methods.description: Reads an 8-bit value from a memory-mapped register at a specified page and register offset.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_read16(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u16 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit value from a memory-mapped register, handling endianness and validating register alignment.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_read32(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u32 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit value from a memory-mapped register, handling endianness and validating register alignment.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_read48(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 48-bit value by composing 16 and 32-bit reads, with validation.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_read64(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 64-bit value as two 32-bit reads.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_write8(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u8 value)
methods.description: Writes an 8-bit value to a memory-mapped register.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_write16(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u16 value)
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit value to a register with alignment check and optional endianness handling.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_write32(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u32 value)
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit value with alignment check and endianness consideration.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_write48(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 value)
methods.description: Writes a 48-bit value by splitting it into 16 and 32-bit components.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_write64(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 value)
methods.description: Writes a 64-bit value as two 32-bit writes.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_probe(struct platform_device * pdev)
methods.description: Probe function initializing the driver, setting up device structures.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_remove(struct platform_device * pdev)
methods.description: Cleanup function called when driver is removed.
